## Description

Formulates equity universe return matrix factorization into binary quadratic programming problems solved via quantum annealers to isolate independent latent alpha factors for statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Large equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 1000), latent factor extraction during high market volatility.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Hedge Funds, Quantitative Equity Desks.

## Required data

Daily and intraday cross-sectional return panels, fundamental factor matrices.

## Caveats

NISQ hardware qubit connectivity limits require graph embedding heuristics.
